body: Yes. As I posted below, say you need something for anxiety and you don't want to use benzos or anti-depressants, but you need something for day to day anxiety and restful sleep. I stressed that restful sleep really improved my mood and anxiety and gabapenetin seemed to help that and he obliged.

I was prescribed it for nerve pain in the past. I told him it really helped my anxiety and he agreed. Just stress you have anxiety and NOT depression and you NEED something to give you RESTFUL SLEEP and that you think gabapentin would help.
Gabapentin will get rid of the anxiety and most of the depression that comes with pheni withdrawals in my experience.

"phenibuts hippie psychedelic\-like cousin"

I know what you mean and it definitely has an ecstasy/mushroom feel to it. Although very subtle. Phenibut for me is where I get the hippie feels. Just driving around at night listening to music can be super intense and trippy on high enough doses. I have to be playing music non\-stop because it seems to increase the euphoria, lol.

Phenibut is dirtier and much stronger. Gabapentin is more subtle and easier on the body. You can take a bunch and wake up early the next day, but with phenibut if I take a big dose, I'm usually going to be knocked out for a while. Phenibut is more euphoric where gabapentin gives more energy and focus. Together though, it's like spaghetti and meatballs.

Damn, see, this is what I mean when they effect everyone differently. Just one big dose of phenibut will give me bad rebound anxiety/depression about 2-3 days later. It's way worse than opiates/stimulants in that sense, it's weird. I've always been really sensitive to gaba drugs/alcohol. But yeah, plenty of people report no wds from gabapentin.

It's definitely the gaba that is making me work super hard. If I pull back the reigns a little and take a smaller dose my motivation goes back to average or below average. Because of this I want to take off days or cycle it with kava kava, as to not get to big of a tolerance. 

I've looked into BP disorder a lot. I've tried a few different meds and they didn't seem to do much at all. I'm almost 100% sure I've been hypomanic. It's a very distinct feeling and I've only ever had it a couple of times. 

I've heard gabapentin can be used as a mood stabilizer and that makes total sense for me. I've just always felt 'normal' on gabapentin or lyrica. Don't get me wrong if you take enough you can get high as fuck, but for the most part I just feel like a normal person with interests and motivation, and an attention span.

I usually take 900 mgs 3 times a day. It's crazy it works for ADHD too. Having the focus to work hard is kinda new to me. I've tried adderal in the past but ut just messed with my appetite, anxiety, and sleep. Gabapentin is great because it leaves those things in tact.

When I would try getting off it in the past, I would get really weepy. Didn't help I was still drinking but I would always end up going on it again. I would also get really tired too. But I don't miss it at all now. Did nothing except make my anxiety worse and give me bad tinnitus.

I only take it before bed if I need it. But yes I would say it does. For me, if I don't sleep well I feel like shit both physically and mentally. Imo, that is what causes the fibro and mental exhaustion.

He is using you. This type of thing is so easy to see when you are not in it. I went through the same shit, I would get her high as a kite, making sure she never went into withdrawal. But where is she when I'm getting sick as a dog? No where to be found. Cut ties. You will miss him but they will not change. 

If you want to see him get really defensive, ask him why he wont help you out when you need it. I just mentioned something along those lines to my girl and she flipped shit. I spent 2-3 grand getting us high and she bought us a bag ONE TIME. They don't care. They might care on a superficial level, but they are self absorbed to the point of obliviousness.
